about: The skeleton of Open Silicon Lab as data (docs/framework/README.md). One home for the framework's own things: the map (map.html) draws this file, and tests/framework.test.mjs checks it against the repository. It is a plan, not the site: the site's own data stays in src/data until a world is rebuilt.

experiment.live: playable on the site today and judged by an engine
experiment.ready: the engine exists; the experiment is not built, or waits for a way to be seen
experiment.words: only words today: a question and something true to notice

states.stage: how far a direction has come, an editorial judgment to compare them, as in src/data/ways.js: 0 an idea, 1 lab demos, 2 prototype chips, 3 early products, 4 in wide use

engines.name: Logic
engines.does: reads a description, checks it against the job, turns it into gates, places and wires them, and grades the tests by the faults they would catch
engines.maths: Boolean algebra, search (annealing, maze routing), fault models

engines.name: Core
engines.does: a small RISC-V processor that runs real programs through an arithmetic unit made of the community's designs

engines.name: Timing and power
engines.does: the slowest path against the tick, and the heat that follows from speed, size and switch generation
engines.maths: delay of a charging wire, energy per switch, power per area

engines.name: Stress
engines.does: what variation, heat, supply dips, ageing, missed defects and radiation do to a design over years in a phone, a car or a data centre
engines.maths: probability distributions and their tails, rate laws for ageing

engines.name: Floor
engines.does: how far a chip is from the limits physics sets on energy and speed
engines.maths: thermodynamics and information theory (Landauer, Carnot), the speed of light

engines.name: Factory
engines.does: a factory where wafers go round the same machines many times: its pace, its queues, its bottleneck

engines.name: Supply
engines.does: what stops, and where, when a place in the chain stops

engines.name: Record
engines.does: replays everything the community added and works out, from the entries alone, what stands, what is broken and what calls loudest
engines.maths: replaying an ordered log; traces that attract and fade

engines.name: Yield and money
engines.does: specks to good chips, chips per wafer, and what a chip costs when the cost of starting is split over few or many
engines.maths: Poisson statistics, splitting a fixed cost

engines.name: Work
engines.does: how fast and at what energy a job runs, given how it is divided: cores, special districts, where the memory sits
engines.maths: Amdahl's law, the cost of moving a number against the cost of using it

engines.name: Scaling
engines.does: what follows when every length shrinks by the same factor, where that rule broke, and how a doubling curve bends

engines.name: Process
engines.does: a recipe of steps acting on a slice through the wafer, and a check of what was built: is it a working switch?
engines.maths: geometry: adding, masking and carving layers of a grid

engines.name: Substrate
engines.does: any kind of switch as a curve, a noise, a delay and an energy: does a 1 survive a chain of them, and what does each step cost?
engines.maths: repeating a curve on itself until it settles or fades

engines.name: Tune
engines.does: a machine with dials, some unlabelled, that drifts: you learn it by trying, and what you learned can be handed over or lost
engines.maths: finding the best setting through noise; learning curves

engines.name: Swarm
engines.does: many simple units with local rules: spikes, cells, trails; what the whole computes, at what energy, and how much damage it survives

givens.name: It computes with switches that move charge
It has two exact states, 0 and 1
One clock tells every part when to move
It follows a stored program, a step at a time
Memory sits apart from the logic
Its switches lie in one flat layer
It is one piece of silicon
It is printed with light through masks, by adding layers and carving them away
It is made in a giant factory
It is designed by a few, with closed tools
It throws information away at every step
It is frozen the day it is made
It is checked by trying cases
The craft of making it lives in people
